parsed.scene_description: A dimly lit warehouse aisle with tall metal racks on both sides. Left side holds large wooden crates and stacked pallets. Right side features blue plastic bins. Fluorescent lights illuminate the ceiling. A forklift is visible in the distant background. The floor is concrete, and the space appears organized but industrial.

objects.label: wooden crate
objects.observation: Large, weathered wooden crate with visible grain and metal corner brackets. Positioned on left side of aisle near foreground. Partially obscured by adjacent rack. Has a white label with black numbers '5814278'. Supported by ground and rack structure.

objects.label: metal shelving rack
objects.observation: Tall, dark blue metal shelving unit extending from left foreground into mid-distance. Supports multiple stacked wooden crates and pallets. Vertical posts bolted to floor. Appears freestanding but integrated into warehouse layout.

objects.label: blue plastic bins
objects.observation: Stacked blue plastic bins on right-side shelves. Bins are uniform in shape and color. Located in upper levels of the shelving unit. Visible under bright overhead lighting. Not obstructed by other objects.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Red forklift parked in the far background, partially obscured by racks. Visible only as silhouette against bright ceiling lights. Appears stationary. No visible operator or cargo.

objects.label: fluorescent light fixture
objects.observation: Bright, rectangular fluorescent light fixtures mounted on ceiling. Emit strong downward illumination. Located above center of frame. Cast sharp shadows on racks and floor. Multiple fixtures visible.
